title: potentilla gibberulosa
intro: Potentilla gibberulosa, commonly known as the rough-leaved cinquefoil, is a flowering plant species within the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and research has highlighted its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla gibberulosa are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which have been identified as key players in the plant's medicinal properties.
